description: Spawns a [[familiar]] that floats slowly around the room on a zig-zag pattern similar to [[File:Collectible The Peeper icon.png|link=The Peeper|alt=|The Peeper]]‍[[:The Peeper|The Peeper]] and fires [[spectral]] and [[homing]] tears.
Using an [[activated item]] rerolls it.
Adds a chance for enemies to [[burn]] upon entering a room.

5% chance to induce [[File:Collectible The Necronomicon icon.png|link=The Necronomicon|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Necronomicon]][[:The Necronomicon|The Necronomicon]]'s effect upon taking damage. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Adds +40 damage to [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s and The Necromonicon-like effects.
Automatically recharges the last energy slot of an [[activated item]], effectively reducing recharge rates by one.

Increases the chance of [[Cards and Runes|tarot cards or playing cards]] dropping after clearing a room, and the chance of finding cards when opening a [[File:Chest.png|link=Chests|alt=|Chest]]‍[[:Chests|Chest]].
[[File:Shop Icon.png|link=Shop|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Shop|Shop]]s can sell [[familiar]]s, which will always be at a discounted price.
Spawns an [[File:Collectible Abyss icon.png|link=Abyss|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Abyss]][[:Abyss|Abyss]] locust [[familiar]] which will fly forward while Isaac shoots.

Picking up [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]]s, even while at full health, can convert them into [[blue spider]]s. The effect may consume hearts needed for healing.
When clearing a room, adds a 33% chance to turn into [[File:Character Azazel icon.png|link=Azazel|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Azazel|Azazel]] until clearing another.
Grants Isaac's [[familiar]]s [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing shots]].
Taking damage has a small chance to destroy the trinket and spawn [[File:Collectible Lunch icon.png|link=Lunch|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Lunch]][[:Lunch|Lunch]].
Upon killing an enemy, has a 5% chance to grant [[flight]] for the rest of the room.

Upon entering an [[File:Angel Room Icon.png|link=Angel Room|alt=|]]‍[[:Angel Room|Angel Room]], spawns 5 wisp orbitals. Giving money to [[File:Beggar.png|link=Beggar|alt=|Beggar]]‍[[:Beggar|Beggar]]s can spawn wisps.
At the beginning of each floor, spawn 4-8 wisps that orbit Isaac and fires tears alongside him.
Increases the chance of [[File:Eternal Heart.png|link=Hearts#Eternal Heart|Eternal Heart|alt=]][[:Hearts#Eternal Heart|Eternal Heart]]s appearing.
Increases Isaac's [[Damage]] for each 'evil' [[item]] or [[trinket]] he possesses.
Increases the chance of [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart|alt=]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s appearing.
Adds a chance to fire a black tooth that deals double [[damage]] and [[poison]]s enemies.
Exploding [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]]s have a chance to drop another Bomb pickup.

Gives a chance to drop a [[File:Half Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Half Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Half Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Half Soul Heart|Half Soul Heart]] when a [[Coins|coin]] is collected.
Increases invincibility time after getting hit.
Increases knockback of tears.
[[File:Treasure Room Icon.png|link=Treasure Room||alt=]][[:Treasure Room|Treasure Room]]s appear in [[Chapter 4]].

Gives a chance to drop a [[File:Half Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Half Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Half Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Half Red Heart|Half Red Heart]] when a [[Coins|coin]] is collected.

Doors can be unlocked without using [[File:Key.png|link=Keys|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Key]][[:Keys|Key]]s. Opening a door this way brings Isaac to an in-between room that resembles [[File:Stage Blue Womb icon.png|link=??? (Floor)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|???]][[:??? (Floor)|???]], with a few [[monster]]s.
Leaves a pool of [[green creep]] under all [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]]s Isaac places, which damages enemies that walk over it.
Tears snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.

When held, Isaac has a 22.22% chance to be revived as [[File:Character ??? icon.png|link=??? (Character)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|???]][[:??? (Character)|???]] in the most recent non-hostile room. Can occur multiple times in the same run.

Gives a 50% chance to add a '?' item to [[File:Treasure Room Icon.png|link=Treasure Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Treasure Room|Treasure Room]]s. Only one item can be taken. The extra items on the alt path are revealed instead.
Pulls [[coin]]s towards Isaac, but ignores other [[pickup]]s.
Locks can be opened with explosions.
Triggers the [[File:Collectible Teleport! icon.png|link=Teleport!|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Teleport!]][[:Teleport!|Teleport!]] effect whenever an [[activated item]] is used.
Grants a chance to gain a random [[syringe]] effect for the current room.
[[File:Poop.png|link=Poop (Disambiguation)|alt=|Poop]]‍[[:Poop (Disambiguation)|Poop]]s explode upon being destroyed.
Gives a chance to drop a [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|alt=|Bomb]]‍[[:Bombs|Bomb]] when a [[Coins|coin]] is collected.
Isaac will fart when he picks up a [[Coins|coin]]. Coins have a higher chance to drop from [[File:Poop.png|link=Poop (Disambiguation)|alt=|Poop]]‍[[:Poop (Disambiguation)|Poop]]s.
Using an active item will drop it onto a pedestal on the ground. Taking damage may result in dropping an owned passive item.

When starting a floor, 25% chance to gain the effect of [[File:Collectible The Compass icon.png|link=The Compass|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Compass]][[:The Compass|The Compass]] for the duration of the floor.
Prevents damage from [[creep]] and [[spikes]].

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] -2 [[tear delay]] (effectively increases fire rate of tears).
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] +1.0 [[fire rate]].
Chance to trigger [[File:collectible The Gamekid icon.png|link=The Gamekid|The Gamekid|alt=]][[:The Gamekid|The Gamekid]] effect upon taking damage.
Picking up [[coin]]s has a chance to give an Active Item charge.
Adds a chance to fire tears that [[slow]] enemies.

Causes [[familiar]]s to stay closer to each other. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] Increases damage and size of all [[familiar]]s by 25%.

Increases the chance of a [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Heart]] dropping after clearing a room, and the chance of finding a heart when opening a [[File:Chest.png|link=Chests|alt=|Chest]]‍[[:Chests|Chest]].
Gives a 50% chance of increasing the value of every [[Coins|coin]] pickup by one.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Decreases Isaac's [[tear delay]] by 20%, and improves the effectiveness of his other [[stat]] upgrades by 33%.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Improves the effectiveness of stat upgrades by 20%.

[[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]] Activates [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] Has a chance to activate the effect of [[File:Collectible The D6 icon.png|link=The D6|alt=|The D6]]‍[[:The D6|The D6]], [[File:Collectible D8 icon.png|link=D8|alt=|D8]]‍[[:D8|D8]], [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[File:Collectible D10 icon.png|link=D10|alt=|D10]]‍[[:D10|D10]], [[File:Collectible D12 icon.png|link=D12|alt=|D12]]‍[[:D12|D12]], or [[File:Collectible D20 icon.png|link=D20|alt=|D20]]‍[[:D20|D20]] (chosen randomly) whenever Isaac takes damage.
Adds a 1/6 chance to spawn a random [[locust]] when killing an enemy.

[[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]] damage will be taken before [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]], [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]], and [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Rotten Heart.png|link=Hearts#Rotten Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Rotten Heart]][[:Hearts#Rotten Heart|Rotten Heart]] damage.
Whenever Isaac clears a room, has a chance to open a neighboring [[File:Red Room Icon.png|link=Red Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Red Key|Red Room]].

Picking up [[coin]]s teleports Isaac to a random room. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] The type of the coin picked up affects the teleport destination.

If Isaac has less than one full [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]] after taking damage, he will be immediately teleported to a random room.
+2 flat [[damage]].

Most non-specific [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Heart]] drops become [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|alt=|Black Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s, but most heart drops are replaced by [[File:Key.png|link=Keys|alt=|Key]]‍[[:Keys|Key]]s.

[[File:Treasure Room Icon.png|link=Treasure Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Treasure Room|Treasure Room]]s are replaced with unique Red Treasure Rooms, offering a Deal with the Devil in place of an item.
When Isaac enters a new room, has a chance to give him a Dice item as a consumable for the current room.
Provides a boost to all [[Attributes|stats]] when Isaac's active item is completely uncharged.
Spawns a [[Familiar#Dips|Dip Familiar]] upon clearing a room.
The last door Isaac went through stays open, allowing him to leave the room even if enemies are in it.
Holds Isaac's [[familiar]]s in place relative to his position.
Has a 25% chance of creating a duplicate of any [[pill]], [[card]], or [[rune]] Isaac uses.
Turns pickups into their doubled versions while Isaac's numbers of coins, bombs, and keys are equal.
Gives a random [[trinket]] effect each room.

Has a chance to spawn a [[File:Collectible Dead Bird icon.png|link=Dead Bird|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Dead Bird]][[:Dead Bird|Dead Bird]] [[familiar]] for the current [[Rooms|room]] each time an enemy dies.
Once per room, using an active item triggers another random active item effect.
Bolts of electricity arc between Isaac and his [[familiar]]s, damaging any enemies between them.

Occasionally causes Isaac to blend into the ground, which briefly [[confusion|confuses]] all enemies in the room. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Can be used to open the [[A Strange Door|Strange Door]] in The Depths.
[[Angel]]s drop [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room items]] instead of key pieces when defeated.
Grants a chance to gain a [[File:Bone Heart.png|link=Hearts#Bone Heart|Bone Heart|alt=]][[:Hearts#Bone Heart|Bone Heart]] upon taking damage.
Spawns a [[Blue Fly]] every time Isaac takes damage.
Items and trinkets that generate [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] or [[Locust]]s will generate twice as many.

Causes most spikes to retract, making them harmless. This includes the door to [[File:Curse Room Icon.png|link=Curse Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Curse Room|Curse Room]]s, [[File:Spiked Chest.png|link=Chests#Spiked Chest|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Spiked Chest]][[:Chests#Spiked Chest|Spiked Chest]]s, [[File:Poky.png|link=Poky|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Pokies]][[:Poky|Pokies]] and their variants.
Gives a chance to drop a [[File:Key.png|link=Keys|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Key]][[:Keys|Key]] when a [[coin]] is collected.
Isaac's tears take on an oblong appearance. They also [[Knockback|push enemies back]].
Improves the fire rate of Isaac's [[familiar]]s.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that copies Isaac's movements and scales with [[damage]] and [[tears]]. If it takes damage, it will die and respawn on the next floor.
Makes two [[File:Secret Room Icon.png|link=Secret Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Secret Room|Secret Room]]s spawn on each floor.
Causes [[familiars]] to orbit Isaac.
Increases the size of Isaac's farts.

Replaces all new chests, except [[File:Mega Chest.png|link=Chests#Mega Chest|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Mega Chest]][[:Chests#Mega Chest|Mega Chest]]s and [[File:Old Chest.png|link=Chests#Old Chest|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Old Chest]][[:Chests#Old Chest|Old Chest]]s, with [[File:Locked Chest.png|link=Chests#Locked Chest|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Locked Chest]][[:Chests#Locked Chest|Locked Chest]]s. Grants one [[File:Key.png|link=Keys|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Key]][[:Keys|Key]] on pickup.
+15% chance for [[File:Treasure Room Icon.png|link=Treasure Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Treasure Room|Treasure Room]]s to have two [[items]]. Only one item can be taken.
Fully recharges Isaac's active item upon entering a boss fight.
Grants an empty [[File:Bone Heart.png|link=Hearts#Bone Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bone Heart]][[:Hearts#Bone Heart|Bone Heart]] upon entering a new floor.

A [[File:Treasure Room Icon.png|link=Treasure Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Treasure Room|Treasure Room]] and [[File:Shop Icon.png|link=Shop|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Shop|Shop]] appear in the [[File:Stage Cathedral icon.png|link=Cathedral|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Cathedral]][[:Cathedral|Cathedral]].

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Tears move shifting left to right on a square-wave-like path. +10 [[Range]] (effective Range remains about the same).
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Tears move shifting left to right on a square-wave-like path. +0.4 [[Tears]], +1.5 Range (effective Range is slightly lower).
Adds a chance to [[petrify]] enemies when entering the room. Killing the petrified enemy [[freeze]]s it.
Isaac has a chance to heal for a [[File:Half Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Half Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Half Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Half Red Heart|Half Red Heart]] upon clearing a room.
Spawns Isaac's severed head as a tear-firing [[familiar]]. Fires [[Tear Effects|piercing]] tears.

Adds the chance to fire teeth that deal 3.2× damage; mechanically identical to the passive item [[File:Collectible Tough Love icon.png|link=Tough Love|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Tough Love]][[:Tough Love|Tough Love]].

[[Devil Deal]]s only cost 1 [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heart]]. [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]] trades still cost 3 soul hearts.

Donating to a [[File:Donation Machine.png|link=Donation Machine|alt=|Donation Machine]]‍[[:Donation Machine|Donation Machine]], [[Category:Modified in Repentance+]][[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[File:Blood Donation Machine.png|link=Machines#Blood Donation Machine|alt=|Blood Donation Machine]]‍[[:Machines#Blood Donation Machine|Blood Donation Machine]], or [[Category:Modified in Repentance+]][[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[File:Confessional.png|link=Machines#Confessional|alt=|Confessional]]‍[[:Machines#Confessional|Confessional]] has a chance to heal Isaac for a full [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]] or spawn a [[File:Beggar.png|link=Beggar|alt=|Beggar]]‍[[:Beggar|Beggar]]. Increases the chance that donating to a Donation Machine will increase Isaac's [[luck]].[[Category:Modified in Repentance+]][[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]] Reduces the chance of the Donation Machine jamming. Donating to a [[File:Beggar.png|link=Beggar|alt=|Beggar]]‍[[:Beggar|Beggar]] has a chance to heal Isaac for a full [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]] or increase luck.
Adds a chance for [[Devil Room|Devil Deals]] to cost [[Coins|money]] instead of [[health]].
While held, counts as one of three items needed to transform into [[File:Transformation Guppy appearance.png|link=Guppy|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Guppy]][[:Guppy|Guppy]].

Decreases [[shot speed]] by 0.5. [[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Increases [[range]] by 4. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] Increases [[damage]] by 0.5.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Adds a chance when entering a room to gain [[File:Collectible Mini Mush icon.png|link=Mini Mush|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Mini Mush]][[:Mini Mush|Mini Mush]], [[File:Collectible Odd Mushroom (Large) icon.png|link=Odd Mushroom (Large)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Odd Mushroom]][[:Odd Mushroom (Large)|Odd Mushroom]], [[File:Collectible Odd Mushroom (Thin) icon.png|link=Odd Mushroom (Thin)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Odd Mushroom]][[:Odd Mushroom (Thin)|Odd Mushroom]], or [[File:Collectible The Compass icon.png|link=The Compass|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Compass]][[:The Compass|The Compass]] for one room.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Adds a chance when entering a room to gain a random passive mushroom item for one room.
Spawns a clot [[familiar]] that mimics Isaac's movements and tears. It dies for the current room after taking too much damage.
Spawns a [[Familiar#Blue Flies|Blue Fly]] from every pile of [[File:Poop.png|link=Poop (Disambiguation)|alt=|Poop]]‍[[:Poop (Disambiguation)|Poop]] that Isaac destroys.
Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns 1-4 [[Locust|White Locusts]] which damage enemies.
Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns a [[Locust|Black Locust]] that does a very high amount of damage.
Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns a [[Locust|Yellow Locust]] that damages and slows enemies.
Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns a [[Locust|Green Locust]] which damages and poisons enemies.
Upon entering a room with enemies for the first time, spawns a [[Locust|Red Locust]] which detonates upon impact with enemies.
Increases the radius of any [[creep]] produced by Isaac.

Occasionally spawns a [[Blue Spider]]. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] Spawns a Blue Spider when completing a combat room.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] [[Rocks]] and their variants drop 1 [[File:Penny.png|link=Penny (Disambiguation)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Penny]][[:Penny (Disambiguation)|Penny]] when destroyed.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] [[Rocks]] and their variants have a 33% chance to drop 1 [[File:Penny.png|link=Penny (Disambiguation)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Penny]][[:Penny (Disambiguation)|Penny]] when destroyed.
Spawns a [[File:Grab Bag.png|link=Sacks#Grab Bag|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Grab Bag]][[:Sacks#Grab Bag|Grab Bag]] upon traveling to the next floor.
+1 [[Luck]]. Adds a chance to drop an extra pickup when opening a [[File:Chest.png|link=Chests|alt=|Chest]]‍[[:Chests|Chest]], destroying a [[machine]], or blowing up a [[tinted rock]].
Gives an [[File:Eternal Heart.png|link=Hearts#Eternal Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Eternal Heart]][[:Hearts#Eternal Heart|Eternal Heart]] at the start of every floor.

Increases the chance of [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|alt=|Bomb]]‍[[:Bombs|Bomb]]s dropping after clearing a room, and the chance of finding Bombs when opening a [[File:Chest.png|link=Chests|alt=|Chest]]‍[[:Chests|Chest]].

[[File:Black Poop.png|link=Poops#Black Poop|alt=|Black Poop]]‍[[:Poops#Black Poop|Black Poop]]s can drop [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|alt=|Black Hearts]]‍[[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Hearts]] when destroyed. [[File:Poop.png|link=Poop (Disambiguation)|alt=|Poop]]‍[[:Poop (Disambiguation)|Poop]] has a chance to turn into [[File:Black Poop.png|link=Poops#Black Poop|alt=|Black Poop]]‍[[:Poops#Black Poop|Black Poop]].

[[File:Dlc na indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-1 |alt=(in Rebirth)|Removed in Afterbirth]][[Category:Modified in Afterbirth]] If Isaac dies to a [[File:Sacrifice Room Icon.png|link=Sacrifice Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Sacrifice Room|Sacrifice Room]]'s spikes, a puzzle piece will appear on his [[Isaac's last will|last will]].
[[File:Dlc a indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-30 |alt=(except in Rebirth)|Added in Afterbirth]][[Category:Modified in Afterbirth]] Dying in a [[File:Sacrifice Room Icon.png|link=Sacrifice Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Sacrifice Room|Sacrifice Room]] while holding it unlocks [[File:Character The Lost icon.png|link=The Lost|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:The Lost|The Lost]]. If The Lost is already unlocked, revives Isaac as The Lost if he dies anywhere, then disappears. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] Also has a 33% chance to reveal the [[File:Super Secret Room Icon.png|link=Super Secret Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Secret Room#Super Secret Rooms|Super Secret Room]] when entering a new floor.
50% chance to grant the effect of a random passive [[Item]] each room.
Grants the effects of a random [[Item Tags mom#Passive Collectibles|Mom item]] each room.

Grants a [[File:Half Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Half Red Heart|alt=|Half Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Half Red Heart|Half Red Heart]] each time a [[File:Key.png|link=Keys|alt=|Key]]‍[[:Keys|Key]] is used. Converts [[File:Half Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Half Red Heart|alt=|Half Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Half Red Heart|Half Red Heart]] pickups into [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]]s.
